name: techpourtoutes
description: Plateforme web Django pour la communauté TechPourToutes.

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p ui/static/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js ui/static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js ui/static/js/alpine.min.js && mkdir -p ui/static/fonts/poppins && cp node_modules/@fontsource/poppins/files/poppins-latin-{300,400,500,600,700}-normal.woff2 ui/static/fonts/poppins/ && mkdir -p ui/static/fonts/newsreader && cp node_modules/@fontsource/newsreader/files/newsreader-latin-{300,400,500,600,700,800}-{normal,italic}.woff2 ui/static/fonts/newsreader/
